source: LeetCode metadata with original BrainHub wording and tests

problems.title: Merge Strings Alternately
problems.summary: Interleave two strings one character at a time, appending the unused suffix of the longer input.
constraints: Inputs may be empty.
Preserve the order within each source string.

problems.title: Find Pivot Index
problems.summary: Return the first index whose left-side sum equals its right-side sum, excluding the value at the index.
constraints: Return -1 when no balance point exists.
Negative values are allowed.

problems.title: Is Subsequence
problems.summary: Determine whether every character of the first string appears in order inside the second string.
constraints: Characters need not be adjacent.
The empty string is a subsequence of every string.

problems.title: Valid Perfect Square
problems.summary: Decide whether an integer is the square of another integer without using floating-point square roots.
constraints: Negative values are not perfect squares.
Zero is a perfect square.

problems.title: Maximum Words in a Sentence
problems.summary: Given several space-delimited sentences, return the largest word count among them.
constraints: An empty collection has maximum zero.
Words are separated by ordinary whitespace.

problems.title: Check If a Double Exists
problems.summary: Report whether two different positions contain values where one is exactly twice the other.
constraints: The two positions must be distinct.
Zero needs two occurrences to pair with itself.

problems.title: Find the Added Character
problems.summary: One string is a shuffled copy of another with one extra character; return that extra character.
constraints: Characters may repeat.
The second input is exactly one character longer.

problems.title: Move Zeroes
problems.summary: Return the array with nonzero values kept in order and every zero moved to the end.
constraints: Preserve the relative order of nonzero values.
Return a transformed array for this practice version.

problems.title: Monotonic Array
problems.summary: Determine whether the sequence is entirely nondecreasing or entirely nonincreasing.
constraints: Equal adjacent values are allowed.
Arrays shorter than two values are monotonic.

problems.title: Shortest Degree-Preserving Subarray
problems.summary: Return the shortest contiguous length that has the same maximum frequency as the full array.
constraints: Return zero for an empty array in this practice version.
Ties use the shortest span.

problems.title: Sort Three Colors
problems.summary: Arrange an array containing only 0, 1, and 2 in ascending color order.
constraints: Return the arranged array.
Inputs contain only the three color codes.

problems.title: Longest Mountain
problems.summary: Find the longest contiguous run that strictly rises to one peak and then strictly falls.
constraints: A mountain needs at least three values.
Plateaus do not belong to a mountain.

problems.title: Find All Anagram Starts
problems.summary: Return every start index where a substring is a permutation of the pattern.
constraints: Return indexes in ascending order.
An empty or longer pattern has no matches.

problems.title: Count Subarrays With Target Sum
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays whose values add exactly to the target.
constraints: Values and the target may be negative.
Count overlapping subarrays separately.

problems.title: Continuous Multiple Sum
problems.summary: Determine whether a contiguous subarray of length at least two has a sum divisible by the divisor.
constraints: A zero divisor asks for an exact zero sum.
The chosen span must contain at least two values.

problems.title: Asteroid Collision
problems.summary: Simulate one-dimensional asteroids; opposite-moving neighbors collide and the smaller magnitude disappears.
constraints: Equal opposing magnitudes destroy both.
Return survivors in their final order.

problems.title: Decode Repeated String
problems.summary: Expand nested count[segment] expressions into their decoded string.
constraints: Repeat counts may contain multiple digits.
Encoded segments may be nested.

problems.title: K Closest Sorted Values
problems.summary: Choose the requested number of values nearest to a target and return those values sorted.
constraints: Break equal-distance ties toward the smaller value.
The input array is sorted.

problems.title: Minimum Positive Window
problems.summary: Return the shortest contiguous length whose positive values total at least the target.
constraints: Return zero when no qualifying window exists.
Input values are positive.

problems.title: Range Flight Bookings
problems.summary: Apply inclusive range seat additions and return the final reserved seats for every numbered flight.
constraints: Booking indexes are one-based.
Ranges include both endpoints.

problems.title: Car Pool Capacity
problems.summary: Given pickup and drop-off events along a route, decide whether passenger load ever exceeds capacity.
constraints: Passengers leave before new passengers board at the same location.
Trips use [passengers, start, end].

problems.title: Simplify Absolute Path
problems.summary: Normalize an absolute Unix-style path by resolving separators, current-directory markers, and parent-directory markers.
constraints: The result starts with one slash.
Parent navigation cannot move above root.

problems.title: Compare Version Numbers
problems.summary: Compare dot-separated numeric revisions after ignoring leading zeroes and missing trailing zero components.
constraints: Return -1, 0, or 1.
Each revision component is nonnegative.

problems.title: Count Windows With Bounded Maximum
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays whose maximum lies inside the inclusive lower and upper bounds.
constraints: Count each distinct index range.
The lower bound does not exceed the upper bound.

problems.title: Reduce Target From Array Ends
problems.summary: Remove values from either end until their sum equals the target, minimizing removals.
constraints: Return -1 when impossible.
Input values are positive.

problems.title: Bag of Tokens Score
problems.summary: Spend power on tokens for score or trade score for power to maximize the highest score reached.
constraints: Each token may be used once.
You may stop at any time.

problems.title: Stone Game VI
problems.summary: Two optimal players alternate selecting shared stones with player-specific values; report whether the first player wins, loses, or ties.
constraints: Return 1 for a first-player win, -1 for a loss, and 0 for a tie.
Both value arrays have equal length.

problems.title: Count Windows With K Odd Values
problems.summary: Count contiguous subarrays containing exactly the requested number of odd values.
constraints: Even values may appear anywhere.
The target is positive.

problems.title: Maximum Circular Subarray
problems.summary: Return the largest sum of a nonempty contiguous span when the array's end connects to its beginning.
constraints: Use each position at most once.
All-negative inputs choose their largest element.

problems.title: Longest Fixed-Difference Subsequence
problems.summary: Return the longest subsequence where every adjacent pair differs by the supplied amount.
constraints: Keep original index order.
The difference may be negative or zero.

problems.title: First Missing Positive
problems.summary: Return the smallest positive integer absent from the array.
constraints: Negative values and duplicates may appear.
The answer is at most length + 1.

problems.title: Candy Distribution
problems.summary: Assign at least one unit to each rating so higher-rated neighbors receive more, minimizing the total.
constraints: Only adjacent ratings impose comparisons.
Equal neighbors need no ordering.

problems.title: Text Justification
problems.summary: Pack words into fixed-width lines and distribute interior spaces as evenly as possible, leaving the last line left-aligned.
constraints: Earlier gaps receive extra spaces when division is uneven.
Every output line has exactly the requested width.

problems.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
problems.summary: Return the longest contiguous length that forms balanced parentheses.
constraints: Only '(' and ')' occur.
The empty string has result zero.

problems.title: Maximal Binary Rectangle
problems.summary: Find the largest axis-aligned rectangle containing only ones in a binary matrix.
constraints: Return area, not coordinates.
An empty matrix has area zero.

problems.title: Scramble String
problems.summary: Determine whether recursive binary splits and optional child swaps can transform the first string into the second.
constraints: Inputs must have equal length.
Characters may repeat.

problems.title: Stock Profit With Two Transactions
problems.summary: Return the best profit using at most two nonoverlapping buy-then-sell transactions.
constraints: Hold at most one share at a time.
Transactions are optional.

problems.title: Stock Profit With K Transactions
problems.summary: Return the best profit using at most the supplied number of buy-then-sell transactions.
constraints: A sale must follow its purchase.
Hold at most one share at a time.

problems.title: Minimum Dungeon Health
problems.summary: Find the minimum starting health needed to move right or down through a gain/loss grid while health always stays positive.
constraints: Start at the upper-left and finish at the lower-right.
Health may increase or decrease in each cell.

problems.title: Shortest Palindrome by Front Additions
problems.summary: Add the fewest characters to the front so the full string becomes a palindrome.
constraints: Return the resulting palindrome.
The empty string is already a palindrome.

problems.title: Count Smaller Values to the Right
problems.summary: For every position, count later values that are strictly smaller.
constraints: Equal values do not count.
Return one count per input position.

problems.title: Russian Doll Envelopes
problems.summary: Return the longest chain where both width and height strictly increase.
constraints: An envelope cannot rotate.
Equal widths cannot nest.

problems.title: Split Array Largest Sum
problems.summary: Split nonnegative values into exactly the requested number of nonempty contiguous parts while minimizing the largest part sum.
constraints: Preserve element order.
Every position belongs to exactly one part.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water on a Grid
problems.summary: Compute water retained by a two-dimensional elevation map after rain.
constraints: Water may escape through every boundary cell.
Return total unit volume.

problems.title: Strange Printer
problems.summary: A printer can overwrite any contiguous interval with one repeated character; return the fewest turns needed for the target string.
constraints: Existing characters may be overwritten.
One turn prints only one character.

problems.title: K Inverse Pairs
problems.summary: Count permutations of 1 through n having exactly k inverse pairs, modulo 1,000,000,007.
constraints: An inverse pair has i < j and permutation[i] > permutation[j].
Return zero when k is unattainable.

problems.title: Ways to Return After Steps
problems.summary: Count step sequences that finish at index zero on a bounded line when each move goes left, stays, or goes right.
constraints: Never leave the array bounds.
Return the count modulo 1,000,000,007.

problems.title: Minimum Job Schedule Difficulty
problems.summary: Partition ordered jobs across consecutive nonempty days, minimizing the sum of each day's hardest job.
constraints: Job order cannot change.
Return -1 when there are fewer jobs than days.

problems.title: Maximum Team Performance
problems.summary: Choose at most k workers to maximize total speed multiplied by the team's minimum efficiency.
constraints: Speed and efficiency arrays align by worker.
Return the result modulo 1,000,000,007.

problems.title: Minimum Taps for a Garden
problems.summary: Each tap waters an interval around its position; return the fewest taps covering the full garden from zero through n.
constraints: Return -1 when complete coverage is impossible.
The ranges array has n + 1 entries.
